goal: Add a minimal observation-only run-to-run controller foundation without granting proposal, budget, model, application, promotion, or rollback authority.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Versioned controller policy and state contracts keep task-class observation separate from the candidate proposal lifecycle.
The CLI estimates explicit proportion metrics with Wilson intervals and exclusions from one exact compatible task-set batch.

State publication is deterministic, content-bound, immutable, idempotent, and fail closed for mixed context, mixed generation, duplicate identities, malformed statistics, tampering, and inexact batch IDs.
The feature performs no model, network, proposer, sandbox, transition, budget, candidate-application, promotion, or rollback operation and preserves existing persisted policy compatibility.
Focused contract checks, capsules, typecheck, build, repository tests, guardrail evaluation, and benchmark evaluation pass.

outcome.summary: The repository now has a contract-first observation-only controller estimator and immutable state store with exact evidence selection, deterministic uncertainty estimates, content-bound identity, and unchanged human-governed authority boundaries.

what_worked: Reusing immutable run records and existing validation seams kept the controller additive and preserved the proposal lifecycle.
Focused tamper and compatibility tests exposed integrity issues before the complete repository gate.
The final complete gate passed 32 test files with 193 passing tests and 6 environment-gated skips.
what_failed: The first complete gate found a capsule test clock older than the refreshed capsule date; the deterministic test clock was advanced and the complete gate then passed.
Diff review found that the initial state identity omitted derived snapshot content and that batch input was silently trimmed; both paths were tightened and covered by regression tests.

calls.name: vitest
calls.purpose: Verify controller estimation, fail-closed semantics, immutable publication, CLI integration, and capsule freshness.

calls.name: pnpm run check
calls.purpose: Run the complete repository verification gate after the final integrity fixes.

calls.name: cavecrew-reviewer
calls.purpose: Audit the final diff for correctness, safety, compatibility, determinism, and fail-closed behavior.

evidence.summary: DAL-023, the supervisor ADR, schemas, and architecture documentation define the observation-only controller contract and authority boundary.
Controller and capsule focused verification passed 9 tests, including exact-batch, tamper, compatibility, uncertainty, and idempotence cases.
All three committed knowledge capsules validated against their current local sources.
The complete gate passed typecheck, build, 32 test files with 193 passing tests and 6 environment-gated skips, capsule validation, policy evaluation, and benchmark evaluation.
Automated diff review findings were fixed; the follow-up review reported no remaining findings.

uncertainty.statement: Content-derived state identity detects mismatched content but does not authenticate a local actor able to replace both the state file and its filename.
uncertainty.resolution: Add an independently protected signature or append-only receipt only if the threat model expands to hostile replacement of the local evidence store.

notes: Automated diff review completed; human merge review has not occurred.
No sensitive-action approval was required or used because the change remained local and observation-only.
